settings.ignoreNitroDescription: Force FreeStickersNext even when you have Nitro
settings.customHyperlinkPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the sticker's name
settings.convertApngDescription: Encoded on-device and sent directly to Discord
settings.deliveryHelp: Stickers are sent as plain links (or direct GIF uploads for animated APNG stickers). GIF stickers are served animated by Discord's own media proxy. Size only changes the source resolution — Discord renders link embeds at a fixed display size.
toast.missingAttachmentPermission: Missing attachment permission in this channel; sending a static sticker instead
toast.lottieUnsupported: Sending Lottie animated stickers is not supported yet
